prompt: Load Chicago's road network from the Data Catalog, data.osm.chicago-roads, and keep the roads that reach into a bounding box of west, south, east and north the user can change, by default SCOUT's routing area, -87.662, 41.859, -87.613 and 41.898. Then plan weather-aware routes across that area with SCOUT's weather routing, whose GNN estimates the weather at every road node from SCOUT's WRF weather run of 6 July 2025 in the Data Catalog: from 1256 West Chicago Avenue to 1410 South Special Olympics Drive, leaving at midnight, weighing rain and wind with SCOUT's default weights. Draw the routes on an Autark map, one colour per route, and compare the routes' travel time, distance and rain and wind exposure in a Vega-Lite chart. The weather routing is not part of the standard node set, so whatever provides it needs installing first.

skip.reason: The Autark map needs hardware WebGPU; the plan and apply half of this fixture still runs offline.
